_comment: The only file you edit to change what the monitor watches. Add a group by pasting its URL into the right region. No script or plist changes needed, and no reload — each scheduled run reads this file fresh. A group must be one the signed-in account has already joined; the collector sees exactly what you would see, so an unjoined group returns nothing rather than erroring. Confirm a new group is reachable BEFORE adding it, or it silently returns nothing: npm run fb:collect -- --group <url> --posts 5, where a group name and a post count mean you are in and 'WARNING: 0 posts' means you are not. Audited 2026-10-08 across all 24 then-unproductive groups: FOUR are configured here but NOT joined and have always returned nothing - RevelstokeCashJobs, 889986741929213 (Revelstoke Employment), 1378531332445868 (Hakuba Buy Sell and Jobs) and 597143303806350 (Nozawa Onsen Buy, Sell, and Jobs). Join them or remove them; while they sit here they look like coverage that does not exist. Ten others ARE joined and simply carry no job adverts, which costs collection time but no extraction money.
